update_frequency: Annual refresh cycle (Assessor 'Open Data Refresh' stories per year); portal shows recent updates

State equalization factor applies on top of AV (a result title referenced a ~3.0 multiplier for 2026); exact final factor per year not confirmed — verify with IDOR.

source_name: Eviction records — Cook County Circuit Court (Eviction/FED cases) + Chicago RLTO
verification_note: Search budget exhausted; from model knowledge. Confirm online case-search coverage of eviction (formerly Forcible Entry & Detainer) cases and Illinois court sealing rules (COVID-era cases sealed; 2022 IL law allows sealing).

Cook County RTLO (2021) extends similar rules to suburban Cook (some municipalities opted out). No general landlord license/registration in Chicago (unlike some suburbs, e.g., Berwyn/Cicero). All unverified this session.
